epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase pipeline deliverable readiness ratio from 85% to 100%
epics.tocConstraintRef: Failed API Slice task resolution bottleneck in the pipeline
requirements: R1: Address the persistent failure of four API Slice tasks (ad35452d, 4d3a32f6, 8502067e, and 72ec0f54) to unblock the final 2 project features.
R2: Resolve the SYSTEM_STALLED state where pipeline readiness is locked at 85%.

slices.title: Patch failing API slices
slices.jtbd: When implementing the API slice fix for this epic, I want to resolve the failing task states, so that the pipeline unblocks and readiness reaches 100%.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the pipeline contains failed API slice tasks (ad35452d, 4d3a32f6, 8502067e, 72ec0f54),
When the backend job processor evaluates their state,
Then the tasks are safely marked resolved and readiness is updated correctly.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Failed task processing engine execution bottleneck
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce failure retry loops from infinite to 0 for specific API tasks

slices.title: Verify API slice patch
slices.jtbd: When implementing the QA checks for this epic, I want to verify the task resolution logic, so that the pipeline fix does not introduce regressions.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the pipeline processor is running in a test environment,
When the updated logic is executed against the stalled API tasks,
Then unit and integration tests confirm the tasks transition to resolved and the readiness metric increases beyond 85%.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Test coverage for pipeline task status transitions
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 100% test coverage on task status transition paths

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease stuck queued task wait time from >4h to <5m
epics.tocConstraintRef: Queued task processing and review resolution bottleneck
requirements: R1: Unblock PR review fallback and wishlist compilation tasks (85feb4bc-7a85-45bf-a637-476d48d00d6a and 68c31f3d-be90-4949-b5df-b741cd52c4ef) that have been stuck in queued status for over 4 hours.

slices.title: Unblock stuck PR review and wishlist tasks
slices.jtbd: When implementing the unblocking logic for this epic, I want to force-process or timeout stuck queued tasks, so that pipeline task execution resumes.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the tasks 85feb4bc and 68c31f3d are stuck in a queued state for over 4 hours,
When the task scheduler runs the unblocking sweep,
Then the tasks are safely picked up or transitioned to a resolvable state.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce stuck task queue time from >4h to <5m

slices.title: Verify unblocking of stuck tasks
slices.jtbd: When implementing the test automation for this epic, I want to simulate stuck queue scenarios, so that the unblocking logic is proven to handle stalled tasks safely.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given tasks mocked in a queued state for over 4 hours,
When the unblocking routine triggers during tests,
Then integration tests verify that the tasks correctly resume or fail gracefully without infinite hang.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Test verification of scheduler timeout bounds
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 100% test coverage on task queue timeout conditions
